_notes.ai-color-palette: Turquoise-on-dark IS the documented brand system color (DESIGN.md §2, chosen in the brief). Used as restrained accent, not neon glow.
_notes.repeated-section-kickers: The ALT · altitude labels are the deliberate, named brand system (the ascent instrument, DESIGN.md §1/§7). They carry information (altitude progression, PEAK/HORIZON waypoints), not generic scaffolding.
